help:
Usage: bend INPUT.bend -o OUTPUT.c [--live]

Compile one Base-importing Bend source to C. Existing outputs are refused.
Options: -o, --output PATH; --live (prepare Base without its cache);
         --help; --version; -- (remaining arguments are input paths).
Supported effects: IO.args/print/print_err/now and File.open/read/size/write/close.
Compiler execution uses one CPU worker. Build emitted C separately.
typeRefusal: check: main: constructor does not belong to goal or field count differs
origin: Literal complete public-help/type/stdout contracts retained independently of the candidate. Version suffix is the canonical source SHA prefix, not the candidate profile versionText.
